info.title: Event Photo Sharing API
info.description: API for event photo sharing with AI face detection

post.description:
Register or login user with Firebase token
Creates user if doesn't exist, returns existing user otherwise

get.description: Get event details (public or with valid access code)

post.description: Validate access code and return event info

get.description: Get all events owned by current user

schema.title: Response Get My Events Api V1 Events Me Events Get

get.description:
Get public events (for home page map)

Args:
    latitude: User's latitude (optional, for nearby events)
    longitude: User's longitude (optional)
    radius: Search radius in km (default: 50)
    limit: Max results (default: 50)

schema.title: Response Get Public Events Api V1 Events Public Get

post.description: Get presigned URL for direct upload to Azure Blob Storage
Confirm upload and trigger face detection

get.description:
Get all media for an event (Gallery Page)

Args:
    event_id: Event UUID
    limit: Max results (default: 50, max: 100)
    offset: Pagination offset (default: 0)
    sort: Sort order - "newest", "oldest", "most_faces" (default: newest)
    has_faces: Filter by face presence (optional)

schema.title: Response List Event Media Api V1 Media Events  Event Id  Media Get

get.description: Get a single media item by ID

delete.description: Delete a media item (owner or uploader only)

get.description: Get all faces detected in a specific media item

post.description:
Search for similar faces in an event
Finds all photos containing the same person as the given face

get.description:
Get all face clusters (groups of people) in an event
Used for "Find People" or "Search Face" page

post.description:
Identify yourself in a cluster ("This is me" button)
Associates your user account with this face cluster

Manually trigger face clustering for an event
(Owner only - for re-clustering or initial clustering)
